jobs.snippet:
Description
The College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Texas A&M University is seeking applications for a full-time, tenured Professor and Head of the Department of Soil and Crop Sciences. The expected start date is September 1, 2027, but is negotiable. This 9-month tenured position includes a majority administrative appointment with a 25% research appointment. The research appointment is negotiable and can be fulfilled through a collaborative effort within the department, Texas A&M AgriLife Research, Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, or other institutional researchers.
